excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<KamilChNethermind> Spent some time reviving warmup as wasn't good enough last time I approached it but now made a proper experiment with nethermind besu and reth as representatives. Very dummy results but showing how much does it affect performance of clients when I isolated only one scenario (Origin).

When running multiple tests at once results are not as clear but when only executing one we were veery surprised.

This kind of result still makes me a bit unsure but results are very accurate with expectations - just way above expectations in terms of poor perf without warming for Nethermind.
